source: robot/scripts/make_sheet.py: 3x4 grid, tags on the mat
frame: sheet: origin at the grid sheet's top-left corner, x right (tag0->tag1), y down the page (tag0->tag3), mm. Tags sit on the mat outside the paper, so their coordinates are negative or past the sheet's width and height.

grid.naming: letter is the row (A nearest the arm), number is the column

print_check: the scale bar must measure 50.8 mm (2.00 in)
tags_note: tag centres, rotations and corner ORDER measured against the printed grid on 2026-10-17 (grid residual 0.18 mm). corners_mm is in the order cv2.aruco reports them for each marker, which is the marker's own rotation, not the sheet axes - matching a rotated tag to an axis-aligned square costs a full tag diagonal (~45 mm) of fit error. Re-measure if the tags are re-taped.
